integrity: Two self-contained exhaustive Python checkers agree and are accompanied by the complete twelve-row census. Independent mathematical review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite exhaustive theorem for binary overlap-free concatenations of exactly nine squares, total length at most 96. It makes no claim for longer lengths; the initial length-48 example and ten-square obstruction predate this classification.
title: First doubling-window spectrum for overlap-free nine-square products
